Subject: Pricing packet + timing check — are we still prioritizing this quarter?

Hi Alicia,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for walking me through ClearPath's ingestion and privacy constraints. As promised, attaching the pricing deck and a one-page commercial summary tailored to the usage profile we discussed (50M tokens/month, mixed chat + embeddings).

TL;DR: I highlighted an options table on slide 6 with dedicated capacity vs hosted hybrid, and a conservative cost estimate with expected monthly token spend. If helpful, Marcus (cc'd) can join a 15-minute walkthrough to call out where the numbers come from and how routing/bursting would work.

Next steps I recommend:
- Quick internal read by your procurement/ops team this week
- 15-minute walkthrough to surface any technical constraints (we can demo the console cost breakdown)
- If everything looks good, we can produce an initial SOW/term sheet for your legal team

Are you still aiming to make a decision this quarter? If the timeline shifted, no problem — tell me what cadence works and we'll adjust.

Thanks — attaching files below.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
E: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com | M: (415) 555-0192

1) The estimate assumes a 12-hour retention for embeddings cache — can you confirm options if we need 30-day retention for longer-term analytics?
2) On the dedicated capacity numbers (slide 6) — if we start hosted and then migrate to Dedicated in Q1, can you provide an interim blended estimate?

We are still trying to close vendor decisions this quarter but procurement asked that we get the retention and migration clarity first. I can do Thu 11/11 at 11:00 PT for a 20-minute call if Marcus can join to cover technical migration impact.

Thanks,
